استشكلتما (form X)
# اِسْتَشْكَلْتُمَا (istaškaltumā) /is.taʃ.kal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اُسْتُشْكِلْتُمَا (ustuškiltumā) /us.tuʃ.kil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
